Definition: to glitter, i.e. be golden in color
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, tsâhab is the word for to glitter, i.e. be golden in color. It appears once, in Ezra 8:27.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâhab is no accident in Scripture — God put it there on purpose.
